WITH s AS (
 SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'
), dd AS (
 SELECT * FROM s QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) = 1
), sales AS (
 SELECT st.store_id,
  sum(s.net_amount) raw_net,
  sum(CASE WHEN s.staff_purchase_flag THEN s.net_amount ELSE 0 END) raw_staff
 FROM s JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = s.store_key GROUP BY 1
), dsales AS (
 SELECT st.store_id, sum(d.net_amount) dedup_net, sum(CASE WHEN d.staff_purchase_flag THEN d.net_amount ELSE 0 END) dedup_staff
 FROM dd d JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = d.store_key GROUP BY 1
), ret AS (
 SELECT st.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) refunds, count(*) n_ret, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) n_ret_ids, count(DISTINCT r.sales_line_id) n_ret_sl
 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = r.store_key
 WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' GROUP BY 1
), rpt AS (
 SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) rpt_gross, sum(returns_net) rpt_ret, sum(net_sales) rpt_net, count(*) days
 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT sales.store_id, raw_net, dedup_net, dedup_staff, refunds, n_ret, n_ret_ids, n_ret_sl, rpt_gross, rpt_ret, rpt_net, days
FROM sales LEFT JOIN dsales USING (store_id) LEFT JOIN ret USING (store_id) LEFT JOIN rpt USING (store_id) ORDER BY store_id

WITH s AS (
 SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'
), dd AS (
 SELECT * FROM s QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) = 1
), sales AS (
 SELECT st.store_id,
  sum(s.net_amount) AS raw_net
 FROM s JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = s.store_key GROUP BY 1
), dsales AS (
 SELECT st.store_id, sum(d.net_amount) AS dedup_net, sum(CASE WHEN d.staff_purchase_flag THEN d.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS dedup_staff
 FROM dd d JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = d.store_key GROUP BY 1
), ret AS (
 SELECT st.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) AS refunds, count(*) AS n_ret, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) AS n_ret_ids, count(DISTINCT r.sales_line_id) AS n_ret_sl
 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = r.store_key
 WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' GROUP BY 1
), rpt AS (
 SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) AS rpt_gross, sum(returns_net) AS rpt_ret, sum(net_sales) AS rpt_net, count(*) AS n_days
 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT sales.store_id, raw_net, dedup_net, dedup_staff, refunds, n_ret, n_ret_ids, n_ret_sl, rpt_gross, rpt_ret, rpt_net, n_days
FROM sales LEFT JOIN dsales USING (store_id) LEFT JOIN ret USING (store_id) LEFT JOIN rpt USING (store_id) ORDER BY store_id

WITH period AS (
  SELECT period_start_date AS d0, period_end_date AS d1 FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period = 5
), sales AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) AS sales_net
  FROM (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) = 1) f
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key, period p
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN p.d0 AND p.d1 AND st.store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1
), refunds AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) AS refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = r.store_key, period p
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN p.d0 AND p.d1 AND st.store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1
), names AS (
  SELECT store_id, arg_max(store_name, valid_from) AS store_name FROM dim_store GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY s.sales_net - coalesce(r.refund_net,0) DESC) AS rank, 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period,
  s.store_id, n.store_name, round(s.sales_net - coalesce(r.refund_net,0), 2) AS net_sales
FROM sales s LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (store_id) JOIN names n USING (store_id)
ORDER BY rank
